text:
Thanks. I rebuilt the start and the brake on top of the approved v8 loop. Attached: your reference sheet, the new start (4 drawings), the new brake (5 drawings), and a GIF of the whole sequence travelling with the real game-frame holds: idle -> start -> loop -> brake -> idle.




Answer to your question: the start does not overshoot. The left foot (the idle's front foot) stays planted while the body accelerates (root 0.03 / 0.07 / 0.12 / 0.144 m), and the start ends exactly on loop drawing 3's passing pose, so the 0.38-0.40 m reach only happens once he is already in the loop. In the start the blade reaches its carry angle a little early, so it never points straight back past the frame edge mid-swing.




Brake: from loop drawing 8 the left foot plants on the idle's front-foot spot, hips 0.26 m, torso leaning back, Key sweeps forward and both hands regrip by drawing 3, the right foot steps back into the idle stance; root 0.15 / 0.08 / 0.04 / 0.01 / 0 m.




Does the full sequence match your reference and read well? At most 3 fixes with drawing numbers and exact values, or "approved". Text only.
